Live report. Built from the City of San Antonio's official building-permit record: 64,535 permits issued in the 12 months through October 16, 2026, pulled October 18, 2026. Coverage is the City of San Antonio's permitting jurisdiction, including its extraterritorial jurisdiction. The register lists one row for every permit-type component an issuance covers, so each permit is counted once, by its permit number; the register's non-construction permits (garage sales, tree affidavits, temporary signs and banners) are not counted, and the city declares a project value on only about 1 in 40 permits, so the report publishes counts, not dollar totals (see Data Sources for why).
